spine.label: Croco 1.0 spine
spine.description: Release-critical package set whose public API, diagnostics, generated artifacts, runtime contracts, and release evidence define the Croco 1.0 compatibility spine.

cli.recoveryAction: Complete CLI spine-readiness diagnostics and smoke evidence, then move cli from maturity.beta.packages to maturity.production.packages when production-ready:check passes.

create-croco-app.recoveryAction: Complete generated app smoke and provenance evidence, then move create-croco-app from maturity.beta.packages to maturity.production.packages when production-ready:check passes.

events-tx.recoveryAction: Complete transactional event dispatch and recovery evidence, then move events-tx from maturity.beta.packages to maturity.production.packages when production-ready:check passes.

idempotency-core.recoveryAction: Complete idempotency contract and diagnostics evidence, then move idempotency-core from maturity.beta.packages to maturity.production.packages when production-ready:check passes.

openapi-spec.recoveryAction: Complete OpenAPI generation drift and docs evidence, then move openapi-spec from maturity.beta.packages to maturity.production.packages when production-ready:check passes.

protocols-core.recoveryAction: Complete protocol contract hardening evidence, then move protocols-core from maturity.beta.packages to maturity.production.packages when production-ready:check passes.

rpc-codegen.recoveryAction: Complete RPC codegen compatibility evidence, then move rpc-codegen from maturity.beta.packages to maturity.production.packages when production-ready:check passes.

testing.recoveryAction: Complete test harness docs and conformance evidence, then move testing from maturity.beta.packages to maturity.production.packages when production-ready:check passes.

positive.testName: registers and resolves a public domain event by its stable event name

negative.testName: rejects duplicate public event names with a typed Problem
reports unsupported runtime requirements with a stable CROCO diagnostic
should throw for missing required fields

positive.testName: validates and returns a public REST request payload

negative.testName: rejects an invalid public REST request payload with a typed Problem

positive.testName: retries transient Problem categories until success

negative.testName: exposes timeout guard failures as a typed Problem from the package root

positive.testName: returns the public span callback result to the caller

negative.testName: propagates a public span callback failure to the caller

positive.testName: samples a valid trace through the public Node telemetry sampler

negative.testName: rejects an invalid public sampling probability with a typed Problem

positive.testName: declares and reads public HTTP middleware capabilities deterministically

negative.testName: rejects an unsupported public HTTP middleware capability with a stable diagnostic

positive.testName: should create new transaction when not in transaction

negative.testName: should throw TxPropagationError when not in transaction
should fail fast when nested transaction client does not support savepoint

Core.description: Framework primitives, context, reliability, transactions, and cross-cutting core utilities

Provider.description: Concrete datastore, SaaS provider, and external service adapters

Protocol.description: API protocol definitions and code generation

Transport.description: Protocol transports that execute application surfaces independently from deployment hosts

Host.description: Runtime lifecycle adapters for Node processes, Lambda invocations, and Cloudflare Workers fetch events

Build Target.description: Build-time entrypoint, output, format, and bundling contracts without runtime lifecycle ownership

Tooling.description: CLIs, scaffolds, migration tools, and repository build-time helpers

admin-react.adapter: Tenant and cross-domain business workspace primitives
features: audited grant, refund, release, and adjustment controls

requiredEnv: Worker-safe IsrCacheStore required for durable Workers ISR
Cloudflare Worker env object supplied by platform

preset-cloudflare.adapter: Workers fetch lifecycle and build-target compatibility facade
requiredEnv: Cloudflare Worker env object supplied by platform

preset-lambda.adapter: Lambda invocation lifecycle and build-target compatibility facade
requiredEnv: AWS Lambda invocation context supplied by platform

preset-node.adapter: Node process/server lifecycle and build-target compatibility facade

states.certified-required: A certified record is required because the package is production-ready in the extension matrix or public docs make a Croco compatibility claim.
states.candidate-optional: A pre-production certification record exists for an extension package; state candidate requires present liveSmoke evidence.
states.not-applicable: No certification record is required until the extension package reaches production maturity or makes a public Croco compatibility claim.

liveSmoke.description: No external live provider credential is required; no-credential local smoke covers the certified trace and browser bridge paths.
Live OTLP export is env-gated by exporter credentials/endpoints; no-credential Lambda preset and forceFlush behavior stay covered in default tests.
Operational live and diagnostics smoke is token/env-gated; local no-credential health endpoints stay covered by default tests.
